justification: Both surfaces show highly schematic stick-limbed human figures, some in rows of repeated small figures and some larger with raised or outstretched arms, together with long straight linear objects (spear/staff-like) that cross the field and relate to the figures, all scattered freely over an unframed rock surface with no groundline. The clearest difference is that B is a dense, crowded composition with large figures apparently grappling/holding weapons and additional ladder-like and hooked signs, while A is sparse, with only a small cluster of tiny figures, one isolated larger figure, and a lone elongated animal-like form far below, so the specific scenes depicted are not the same.
